roles.heading: Large editorial serif headings with compact sans-serif controls.
roles.graph: A sparse authority graph with fine directed links, a small number of readable nodes, and clear spatial hierarchy.
roles.source_inspector: A compact, legible panel for the selected node, relationship, and source URL.
roles.sample_labels: Clearly label illustrative cases and sample data.

reject_when: The graph becomes a dense hairball or its links obscure labels.
The design uses neon glow, excessive gradients, or generic KPI cards.
Legal examples look like verified opinions when they are illustrative.
A source inspector hides the selected node or omits source provenance.
Ranking or graph position implies legal validity or current precedential status.
